observations.claim: The cosine-alignment savings variant reduced the incumbent to 11.29829. It improved instances 1, 3 and 4 and regressed on 0, 2 and 5. It also lowered the demand bonus, so the gain cannot be assigned to angle alone.

next_search_advice.direction: Explore adaptive directional strength while preserving the new savings skeleton.

memory_action.name: directional-savings
memory_action.description: CVRP angular alignment in a savings-based constructor
memory_action.body:
**Why:** Round 7 candidate 1 used savings times a cosine-law factor and a weaker demand bonus. Mean distance fell to 11.29829, with mixed per-instance effects.

**How to apply:** Keep this candidate family as a reference. Tune alignment cautiously and inspect instance effects; angle alone was not isolated.

**Limitations:** Frozen six-instance CVRP development suite and current evaluator only.
